text: 商务部部长助理张力18日在国新办新闻发布会上介绍，今年前8个月，我国进口增长22%，为2021年以来最快，预计全年进口额有望再创新高。（上证报）
text_en: Assistant Minister of Commerce Zhang Li said at a State Council Information Office press conference on the 18th that in the first eight months of this year, China's imports grew by 22%, the fastest since 2021, and the full-year import value is expected to hit a new high. (Shanghai Securities News)
